code_requirement: Commit 7448f54 or later: grasp-axis instructions (left-right / front-back) and the current planner output contract.

vlm.source: Planner R8, step 2000 (fine-tuned from the R6 planner on 2000 synthetic layouts with two-axis grasp labels).
vlm.use: B/C planner. Writes the current output contract (assessments with free_axes, plan with grasp_axis).

measured.known_weakness: Does not use the narrow gaps between touching cubes: on 36 accessibility scenes its first plan was executable in open 12/12, one-axis-blocked 1/12, fully boxed 0/12. Choose the scattered-scene task (notebook v3.0) for comparisons.

vla_hier.source: access_hier_6000 step 6000: continued from the varied-start grounding model with 1,923 single-transport demonstrations (axis instructions, recovery after a failed grasp) plus replay.
vla_hier.use: B/C: executes one instruction such as 'Pick up the cube number 3 with the fingers front-back and place it in the right storage zone.'

vla_single.source: scattered_single_3000 step 3000: the earlier whole-task model continued on 196 whole-scene demonstrations of scattered training scenes (seeds 900000+, separate from the 24 validation scenes).
vla_single.use: A: receives only the whole-task command. Matched to the scattered-scene task.

replaces.note: Clustered five-cube model; still downloadable from the first release.

evidence_36_scenes_seed42.scenes: 12 families x (open / one-axis-blocked / fully boxed), validation split
evidence_36_scenes_seed42.reading: The hierarchy helps when cubes are spread out; it does not help yet when cubes are packed together.

evidence_scattered_24_scenes_seed42.scenes: scenes_v3/scattered_validation (24 scenes: 5 with 4, 9 with 5, 10 with 6 misplaced cubes)
evidence_scattered_24_scenes_seed42.models: A = vla_single above; B/C = vla_hier and vlm of this release; C loop = student_strategy_c0_v2.py
evidence_scattered_24_scenes_seed42.reading: With a matched whole-task model, A and C are level on scattered scenes. The B/C robot policy placed only 31 of 117 instructed target cubes in B (26%): execution, not planning, limits the hierarchy.
